usage: Read Playback time conversion and BeatTiming.ProcessBeatTaps. Adapt the bounded tap interval-averaging approach; no verbatim C# source or host service imported.
modifications: Keep caller-owned media time instead of static Playback runtime/BeatSynchronizer. Define explicit quarter-note BPM, configurable meter/origin, strict future boundary queries and finite budgets. Use eight accepted taps, four before publishing a BPM estimate; ignore bounce and reset on long/backward intervals. No phase smoothing or automatic beat-lock claims.
